subject: Horizon expansion velocity: stage grooming + CS handoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>; Ryan Chou <ryan.chou@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon expansion velocity & CS handoff

Team — looping in Monica to confirm CS readiness & stage signals for Horizon. Quick context: Horizon is evaluating a Q3 expansion (embeddings + hosted inference) that would move them from our Starter tier to a Dedicated pool. Sales view: forecast showing ~$220k ARR expansion, closing window mid-August. Before we commit the number in the forecast we need a clean CS validation on adoption metrics and gating items.

Ask: Monica — can you confirm the following by EOD today if possible?
- Current active users and top 3 teams using embeddings (monthly DAU/MAU).
- Evidence of POC success (screenshots or short notes).
- Any operational blockers (SAML, regional replication, logging) that would affect a Q3 rollout.

If CS is comfortable, I’ll open the commit in the forecast and link legal/finance. I’ve attached the rough MAP we shared in the demo.

Attachments: Horizon-MAP-v2.xlsx (MAP for expansion)

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon expansion velocity & CS handoff

Thanks Priyom — quick status from CS after our internal sync this morning.

1) Adoption signals
- Active seats: 42 (20% week-over-week growth last 30 days) across Clinical Insights, Internal Search, and Research Ops.
- Embeddings calls: avg 18k calls/day over last 7 days, latency within expected envelope for Hosted plan.

2) POC evidence
- Clinical Insights delivered a small pilot: 3 workflows instrumented; reported 25% faster triage time in the pilot. Screenshots & short case notes attached in the Drive link.

3) Operational blockers
- SSO: customer prefers our IdP metadata be pushed via SAML. We’ve scoped a quick SAML setup (no vendor cooldown) — expected 5 business days work for their infra team.
- Data residency: Horizon wants EU logging off by EoQ for their European clinics — they’ll accept our regional routing but want audit log exports retained for 12 months.

CS recommendation: We are comfortable moving to "Commit stage" for Q3 conditional on: (a) SAML onboarding plan agreed, (b) support SLA clarified for Dedicated, and (c) Finance confirms billing cadence.

I’ve attached a usage snapshot (horizon-usage-snapshot-20260714.csv) and a brief MAP update. Happy to walk through with the account team.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>; Ryan Chou <ryan.chou@horizonhealth.com>; sales-ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon expansion velocity & CS handoff — commit ask + next steps

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Monica — that aligns with what I wanted to see. Quick summary and next steps so we can cleanly pull into the forecast commit review later this week: 

Summary (from Monica’s update):
- Signals: adoption and embeddings usage show sustained growth; pilot outcomes positive.
- Blockers: SAML onboarding, EU audit-log retention, and SLA clarification for Dedicated.

Proposed actions (timeline + owners):
1) Sales Ops (sales-ops@redwoodinference.com) to create a commit line in the Q3 forecast for $220k ARR — action: Priyom to confirm by EOD.
2) CS (Monica) to send SAML onboarding checklist and proposed timeline to Horizon infra; target: complete within 5 business days of PO.
3) Legal/Finance to confirm billing cadence and SLA language for Dedicated (Karthik to loop Finance).
4) AE/CS cadence: 30-min readiness call with Horizon on Mon 19 Jul 10:00 PDT — confirm attendee list.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/companies/HZ-3491 | Draft DocuSign: https://docs.redwood/ds/Hz-3491-draft

Attachments: I’ve uploaded the updated MAP to the Drive link and attached the usage snapshot Monica sent.

Can Priyom confirm you want Sales Ops to pull the commit now? If yes I’ll mark the deal as Commit-Pending-CS in our forecast and route Finance.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>; Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon expansion velocity & CS handoff — commit ask + next steps

Thanks all — appreciate the clear summary. We reviewed internally and are comfortable moving forward provided: 
- SAML onboarding plan is documented and we get a dedicated technical contact at Redwood.
- SLA for Dedicated includes 99.5% uptime and a 4-hour P1 response during business hours (we can discuss extended support later).
- Invoice cadence: quarterly in arrears is preferred.

Monica — can you send proposed SAML checklist and point-person?
Priyom/Karthik — July 19 at 10:00 PDT works for the readiness call; I’ll send an invite and include Ryan from infra.

Best,
Sarah Lee
Director of Digital Platforms, Horizon Health
sarah.lee@horizonhealth.com
